name: Onii-chan Zanmai
source:
My name is Rei Nakajima. I'm surrounded by girls with strong characters. I am now embarrassed by the fight between my sister and my girlfriend. Can I resist my sister's seducement and spend a peaceful summer vacation?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ047673.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我叫中岛零。身边的女孩子一个比一个有个性，而现在，妹妹和女朋友之间的争斗更让我不知如何是好。我能抵挡住妹妹的诱惑，安安稳稳过完这个暑假吗？

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ047673.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
